facts.value: Where students opt to study two bachelor's degrees simultaneously – referred to as a 'conjoint degree' or 'double degree' – an extra year of study is added.

Consistently high-performing students may also be invited to complete the 'honours' program. The bachelor with honours usually requires an extra year of study with an extra honours thesis/dissertation.

Some honours degree courses also offer a postgraduate diploma (PGDip) as an exit qualification, which often consists of the same workload but with added flexibility. A PGDip does not usually require a dissertation.
Many other specialized bachelor's degrees are offered as well. Some are in very specialized areas, and others are offered only at a limited number of universities.
